name: caption-camera-follow
title: Camera Follow Captions
description: One sentence written across a world far larger than the frame. Each word is sized against everything already written, so the block grows geometrically and the camera pulls back at a steady rate to keep landing the new word at the same size. Old words stay lit and simply become small.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the highlighted words. gold is the original.

variables.label: Framing
variables.description: Air the camera leaves around the written block, so the words land larger or smaller in frame.

variables.label: Smear
variables.description: Scales the radial motion blur each camera move carries, from none to a heavy streak.
